about_the_game:
Uncover the secrets of an ancient organization and explore the corrupted lands shaped by Valeriano’s memories, a young man pulled into a fate far greater than himself. Master cosmic artifacts and defeat the relentless creatures that hunt you.

In this action roguelite, you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously, mixing combos, elements, and abilities to create devastating attack chains and annihilate any threat.

Push through each zone, recover your memories, and grow stronger with every attempt… If you die, you lose only the faintest fragments of who you were.

Sole Salvation is the first game by METEORA, an independent studio created by a solo developer.

MASTER YOUR WEAPONS AND DISINTEGRATE YOUR ENEMIES

In this Action Roguelite, the key to survival is mastering the rhythm and moves of your ranged and melee weapons.

In every run, you carry two weapon types, melee and ranged: use both at any moment according to your strategy, without ever having to equip or manually swap them.

Each weapon has its own combat style, traits, and combos, which are amplified by the wide range of abilities and powers you gain during the run.

Combine attacks, upgrade your arsenal, and forge your own path to survival.

POWER UP WITH EVERY ATTEMPT

Collect echo fragments with every attempt and use them to permanently restore Valeriano's memories. Upgrade Valeriano’s weapons, abilities, and stats to become stronger and disintegrate the creatures that stand in your way.

Connect with Evanescences, faint memories that vanish upon death. Collect hundreds of different evanescences, each influenced by the weapons you choose, and craft your build, making every run unique and unrepeatable.

Die, adapt your strategy, and deepen your awareness.

A WORLD SHATTERED BY COSMIC LAWS

A hidden organization has triggered the event known as the “Sole Salvation.”
In an instant, humanity is overwhelmed: people's heads detach from their bodies and float motionless in mid-air, staring at a massive beam of light tearing through the sky. The world twists under the impact of incomprehensible cosmic forces: fractured landscapes, distorted architecture, and fragments of reality contaminated by an unknown presence.

You play as Valeriano, a survivor of the event, pulled into a fate far greater than himself.
Lost in a dreamlike and unstable reality, you must fight your way through corrupted memories and distorted visions to uncover the intentions of the organization behind the Sole Salvation, save your loved ones, and confront the redemption of a past that resurfaces.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th generation) / AMD Ryzen 5 (2000 series or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 6400
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High Definition Audio / DirectX 11 compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (11th generation) / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / 5600X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High Definition Audio / DirectX 11 compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: Sole Salvation is an action roguelite hack and slash where you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously. Recover your thoughts to combine your abilities, defeat the creatures that hunt you, and advance through the corrupted lands of your memories in search of redemption.
